name: fyerstbt
description: Fyerstbt - Fyers TBT 50-level depth for the 15 best signal stocks, one Parquet file per minute

parts.name: logs
parts.why: Recorder logs. The recorded Parquet files are in day folders (<yyyymmdd>) here, or under %FYERSTBT_DATA_DIR% if set - copy those separately, they are large.

parts.name: recordings
parts.why: Recorded TBT days (one folder per day, ~40 MB each): research data that cannot be downloaded again.

steps.name: Python packages for the TBT recorder (protobuf, websocket-client, pyarrow)
